title: feat(app-shell): prefill the first organization name from the sign-up e-mail
body:
Fixes #30136

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：云端注册后自动弹出的「创建组织」对话框，名称不再是空的。企业邮箱用域名推出公司名（`jane@acme.com` → `Acme`），公共邮箱（gmail、qq、163 等，代码里的闭合清单）用「张三的组织」。用户可以改，也可以直接点创建；不会自动建组织。
- 为什么改：执行 cloud#3559 裁决 A。新用户验证完邮箱后必须先想一个组织名才能进去，这是通往第一个应用路上唯一要用户动脑的一步，生产上 20 个新注册里有 1 个明确停在这里。
- 风险与回滚：只影响「还没有任何组织」的用户第一次看到的输入框初值；再建第二个组织仍是空的。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR，没有数据或接口变化。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/defaultOrganizationName.ts`（域名规则与公共邮箱清单）、`CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`（只在打开那一刻取默认值的那段）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `defaultPersonalName`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/` ，预期全部通过，其中 `prefills a first organization from the e-mail` 一组覆盖 gmail 用户（中英两种语言）与 acme.com 用户。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `defaultOrganizationName({ email, name })`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/defaultOrganizationName.ts`), a pure function returning either `{ kind: 'company', name }` or `{ kind: 'personal', person }`, or `null` when there is no usable e-mail.
  - **Work domain:** the registrable label, capitalised. The rule is the smallest one that handles the common multi-part suffixes without the Public Suffix List: the label left of the TLD, except under a two-letter country TLD whose second-level label is one of a closed set of registry-run labels (`co`, `com`, `net`, `org`, `gov`, `edu`, `ac`, `or`, `ne`, `go`, `gob`, `ltd`, `plc`), where it is the label before that pair. So `acme.com`, `mail.acme.com`, `acme.co.uk`, `acme.com.cn`, `eu.acme.co.jp` all give `Acme`. A suffix this misses gives a visible, editable guess, not an error.
  - **Public mailbox domain:** a closed list in code (`PUBLIC_MAILBOX_DOMAINS`, which carries every domain the card names plus similar providers); a subdomain of a listed domain counts too (`vip.qq.com`), while a domain that merely ends in a listed name does not (`notgmail.com`). Unknown domains are work domains, as ruled.
  - **Personal form fallback:** a user with no name, a blank name, or a name equal to the address itself falls back to the e-mail's local part (`zhang.san@gmail.com` → `zhang.san`).
  - **Punycode:** a work label spelled `xn--…` would show as gibberish, so it takes the personal form instead.
- **`CreateWorkspaceDialog`** takes `user`, `organizations` and `isOrganizationsLoading` from `useAuth()` (it already called it) and prefills the name when the dialog opens. The personal form is rendered through the new `workspace.defaultPersonalName` key (`{{name}}'s organization` / `{{name}}的组织`), so all ten locales get it, not just en/zh. The default is read only at open time: creating the organization moves `organizations` off zero mid-submit, and the name being submitted must not change.
- **Scope decision, first organization only.** The ruling scopes the default to 「注册后给组织起名这一步」, the naming step after sign-up. So the prefill applies only when the user's organization list is known and empty (not still loading). That covers the auto-open after sign-up and `?create=1` for a zero-org user. Creating a second organization still opens empty, because a second default from the same e-mail would just repeat the first organization's name. The check reads the auth context, so no new prop is added to the exported component and every caller behaves the same.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** the new `workspace.defaultPersonalName` key is in all ten packs, and the organisation-noun vocabulary pin (`organizations-picker-vocabulary-5215.test.ts`) now lists it.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/i18n` patch (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private and ships inside the Console build).

## Tests

- `__tests__/defaultOrganizationName.test.ts` (new) covers the domain rule (including the multi-part suffixes and the generic-TLD control), every entry of the closed list, the named domains, the subdomain and look-alike cases, the name fallbacks, punycode, and the `null` inputs (acceptance 4).
- `__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx` gets a new top-level `describe`. The harness `t` can now answer from a real built-in pack, so the en and zh values themselves are what's tested:
  - a gmail user sees the personal default in en (`Zhang San's organization`) and zh (`张三的组织`), and one submit creates it and provisions its environment (acceptance 1, 3);
  - an `@acme.com` user sees `Acme` in both locales (acceptance 2, 3);
  - the field stays editable;
  - controls: a user who already has an organization, whose list is still loading, or with no list at all opens with an empty name;
  - the name does not change while the dialog is open when the organization list moves off zero.

## Acceptance notes

- Hyphenated labels keep their hyphen (`acme-labs.com` → `Acme-labs`); only the first letter is capitalised, which is how the card states the rule. The user sees it and can edit it.
- The Russian value is `Организация {{name}}`, with the name left in the nominative. Declining arbitrary personal names is out of reach for a template.
- Not browser-verified against a live cloud stack. The dialog behaviour is pinned at component level with the real en/zh pack values.
- Out of scope, held for the cloud lane per the card: the stale comment in cloud's `packages/service-cloud/src/cloud-stack.ts`.
